Grab Your Crew for New Adventures
In Wisconsin, we encourage residents and visitors to wonder freely – to take what you
already know and love about the area and consider: What else might you discover?
Take, for example, Peninsula State Park’s Eagle Tower. In 2021, a new structure
opened to give visitors with limited mobility improved access to ocean-like views
of Green Bay. With an 850-foot wheelchair-accessible ramp, hikers can seamlessly
transition to the treetops before finding themselves at the overlook – a view you
can’t leave Wisconsin without seeing.
So, here’s to wandering – and wondering – toward new memories.
In Wisconsin, they’re always waiting.
